entries.modifications_and_rationale: Integer paise + integer basis points (HCC DEC-023); validated tiers; half-open non-overlapping occupancy bands (donor inclusive bands can match a boundary twice); bps summed and rounded once, half away from zero; negative result is an error; donor nightsBetween() dropped in favour of HCC nights().

entries.accepted_use: Production clock/date adapter: converting UTC event timestamps to the property's calendar date for display and validation.
entries.excluded_uses: Deciding or advancing the business date; night audit; fiscal-period assignment.
